sql_templates.description: Retrieve potential add candidates based on latest trading signals and relative strength.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT 
    h.symbol, 
    s.company_name, 
    s.sector, 
    s.trading_signal, 
    s.relative_strength, 
    h.qty 
FROM 
    portfolio.holdings h 
JOIN 
    scores.stage_snapshots s ON h.symbol = s.symbol 
WHERE 
    s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) 
    AND s.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY') 
ORDER BY 
    s.relative_strength DESC 
LIMIT 10;

sql_templates.description: Identify potential trim candidates based on latest trading signals.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT 
    h.symbol, 
    s.company_name, 
    s.sector, 
    s.trading_signal, 
    s.relative_strength, 
    h.qty 
FROM 
    portfolio.holdings h 
JOIN 
    scores.stage_snapshots s ON h.symbol = s.symbol 
WHERE 
    s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) 
    AND s.trading_signal = 'SELL' 
ORDER BY 
    s.relative_strength ASC 
LIMIT 10;
